issue.description:
Field evidence gathered 2026-10-23 on codinghome: a sweep of all 92 bead-rs workspaces under /home/coding, git object accounting in the largest repos, and every bead invocation in agent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (32,149 calls) and ~/.codex/sessions (80,311 calls). Counts are regex-based and approximate.

Problem: when automatic publication fails after the mutation's transaction committed, every mutating command exits 1, the same code as an internal failure that changed nothing. The message says the mutation is committed, but the exit code tells the caller it failed. Of 4 occurrences in the transcripts (update, update, close, create), 2 were followed by the same mutation within the next five calls. `redact` documents the same case under exit 1 today.

Scope:
- New exit code 6, "mutation committed; checkpoint publication failed", for every mutating command including manifest commit and redact. The message is unchanged and still names the remedy.
- Exit-code tables in top-level and per-command help, capabilities, and research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md are updated. NEEDLE compatibility holds: 6 is still nonzero.

Acceptance:
- Fault-injected publication failure: exit 6, the mutation is visible on re-read, and a following `bead sync flush-only` publishes it.
- Every other failure keeps its current code.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.notes: Verified by this dispatch (no files changed): exit-6 feature landed+pushed at 64ae82d6, verified at HEAD 3b0553f2.
